text.en:
The term of the Presidential Committee to Study Government Corporations (PCSGC) is extended up to
December 31, 1979 and it is further directed that the Committee submit its report to the President/Prime
Minister on or before said date.

The Committee is authorized to use the unexpended balance of its appropriations as of June 30, 1979
for its operating expenses during the period July 1, 1979 to December 31, 1979.
This Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 4th day of September, in the year of Our Lord, Nineteen Hundred and
Seventy-Nine.
